data.one_liner: Custom animated stacked pages for side menu buttons.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that creates an animated stacked page layout with a foreground widget and background widgets, primarily designed for customizable side menu buttons or sharing actions.
use_when: You want to build custom animated side menus or sliding drawer-like layouts.
You need an animated floating action button linked to stacked foreground and background widgets.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based animations or Rive/Lottie assets.
You require standard Material navigation drawers.
strengths: Easy to set up with foreground and background widgets.
Provides built-in controls for animations, duration, curves, and click-to-dismiss behavior.
weaknesses: Limited to stacked page sliding animations.
Not documented for complex multi-screen navigation routing.
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedStack(
  backgroundColor: Colors.white,
  fabBackgroundColor: Colors.black,
  foregroundWidget: Container(),
  columnWidget: Container(),
  bottomWidget: Container(),
)
